catalogue_requests.reason: The catalogue has no class for a no-input safe-state routine. cap.device.configure.v1 writes named state fields, while the safe state is a pair of switch-off commands (IG1 OFF, IG2 OFF, DG OFF) that must also run during an e-stop. SAFE-045 needs this extension as the independent stop.

notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the SerialDriver helper. A SerialDriver is a configuration-only command map that writes a line and reads one reply; this package is a direct Driver over the card's entry symbol collectors.serial_client:SerialClient so a write can verify the controller with IGB or DGS and reject an INVALID reply instead of reporting it as applied. The wire syntax is unchanged (DS IG, IGB, DGS, IG1 ON/OFF, IG2 ON/OFF, DG ON/OFF). The gate was run on the fake backend only; no hardware was attached, no upstream code was run or installed, and no human review or hardware run is claimed (reviewed_by stays null). SCOPE: this package drives the GP350 RS-232 profile. NOT COVERED: the INFICON VGC402 profile (its ACK/ENQ handshake at collectors/serial_client.py:50-70 and its reply format), the GP350 analog-output/ADS1115 profile (the card's other entry symbol), the RS-485 addressed form (#AA prefix), and the repository's CSV/InfluxDB collector and dashboard layers. The GP350 pressure reply 9.90E+09 is not reported as a number: the driver raises MHS.DEVICE.FAULTED, because the clone documents it as the no-valid-reading sentinel. Every write reads the switch back; INVALID is accepted only when the readback already has the requested state, and an OK whose readback disagrees raises MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET (README.md:139 documents that DG ON can answer OK while DGS stays off). RISK: R2, because IG1/IG2/degas are hot-cathode filament and degas heating controls; the clone states no independent hardware e-stop, so estop_physical_ref is deliberately unset and the independent stop is the x-cap.alphatra.safe_state.v1 action with safe_state=True, which sends the same off commands as the @estop over the same serial line. This is a software stop over the controller interface, not a physical e-stop. The loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package at R2. WARNING: G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is expected for this package because every actuation is a boolean switch, so no numeric Limit exists on an actuating capability and SAFE-014 has nothing to probe; the suite awarded CL2 and every other CL3 test passed. No limit was fabricated to clear it. The package declares no numeric Limit at all; the SerialClient baudrate, byte size, parity, stop bits, terminator and timeout defaults are module options, not device bounds. The fake is an in-memory stand-in over the SerialClient surface (send_command and close), with every number marked # placeholder; it does not reproduce the 9.90E+09 sentinel with both filaments off or the high-pressure DG ON case, and those gaps are listed in fake.py and facts.md. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. The catalogue request above is the only extension id used.
